mods.name: FNS_Self-Planting_Trees
mods.author: FlufferNutterSandwich
mods.description: The trees immediately replant themselves in the same spot after you cut them down.  It also drastically removes tree seeds, so there is less hassle with inventory management and replanting.

mods.description: This mod reduces zombie reach so they aren't slapping you outside of spear range.  FNS was given permission by Khaine, the original author, to recreate this mod on Nexus.  Khaine did the work, all credit is rightly his.

mods.description: Forces all new player spawns into forest biomes during random world generation. For 7D2D 2.2 Stable.

mods.name: Just_Cook_It

mods.description: Grilling and boiling meat no longer require skills as it is just common sense. Also tweaks recipe costs for Charred, Boiled and Grilled meats.

mods.description: This modlet adds POIs that are needed for worlds that were created with Teragon (mainly bridges and other road parts). Some of the POIs are modified vanilla POIs.

mods.author: Asylum Modding Team
